name: Dawngate Opalthread Evening Glove
description: Floor-length opera gloves in ivory biopearl silk, woven with opalescent thread that shifts from cold blue to warm amber under different lighting conditions. The upper arm is finished with a laser-cut fretwork cuff in matching fabric, edged with micro-crystal beading sourced from New Osaka artisans. Available in a chrome-cover variant with an extra seamless inner sleeve of matte polymer that conceals chrome hands without breaking the silhouette.
functionality: Chrome-cover liner option provides seamless cosmetic concealment for chrome hands at Spire-level events. Micro-crystal edge is scratch-resistant. Biopearl silk is temperature-regulating and stain-repellent.
what_it_says: You belong in this room and you dressed for it three days in advance.
story_hooks: The chrome-cover liner of a pair left at a Spire gala contains a hidden data port — someone was running an intelligence op and left in a hurry.
A Tier 1 tailor produces near-perfect counterfeits using salvaged opalescent thread; Dawngate's legal team is hunting the source.
A synthetic attendee commissioned a custom extended version — the gloves reach the shoulder to cover non-human arm proportions, and they're the most elegant thing in the room.

physical_description.visual_profile: Ethereal floor-length opera gloves that extend from fingertip to upper arm, creating an elongated, elegant silhouette. The fabric appears to shimmer and shift with movement, creating an iridescent quality that commands attention in dim lighting. On tier-1 bodies, they read as pure luxury; on augmented limbs, they signal tasteful concealment of chrome.
physical_description.fit: Precision-tailored compression fit through the palm and fingers, gradually relaxing to a loose drape at the forearm and upper arm. Seamless construction through the hand; the chrome-cover variant features an inner polymer sleeve that molds invisibly to cybernetic limbs without visible seams.
physical_description.primary_material: Biopearl silk (primary); opalescent synthetic thread woven throughout; micro-crystal beading (New Osaka origin); matte polymer inner sleeve (chrome variant only)
physical_description.texture: Smooth, liquid-like surface with a subtle ribbed structure from the opalescent weave. The laser-cut cuff has dimensional relief—fretwork creates negative space revealing skin or chrome beneath. Micro-crystals catch light and create tactile texture under fingertips.
physical_description.color_scheme: Ivory base with opalescent threading that shifts from cool blue-cyan in cool light to warm amber-gold in warm light. The micro-crystal beading adds white and prismatic highlights throughout the cuff.
physical_description.closures: None—friction-fit design. The upper arm cuff sits snugly but slides on/off easily; no zippers, snaps, or fasteners.
distinctive_features: Opalescent thread weave creates chromatic shift (blue-to-amber)
Laser-cut geometric fretwork on upper-arm cuff
Micro-crystal beading sourced from New Osaka artisans
Chrome-cover variant with seamless inner polymer sleeve designed to conceal chrome cybernetic hands
Floor-length construction extends past typical opera length
Zero visible seams in standard variant (seamless hand construction)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—Dawngate Atelier is a high-end corpo fashion house. Pricing in Φ reflects exclusivity and artisan craftsmanship.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corpo elite, augmented socialites, and high-tier operatives who view chrome augmentation as something to frame rather than hide. Signals wealth, taste, and comfort with body modification. The chrome-cover variant suggests someone who wants their augmentations present but refined—not militant or street.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine. These are investment pieces maintained carefully. The biopearl silk resists staining; micro-crystals never dull. A worn pair would show crystal loss or fading of the opalescent effect—rare enough to be noteworthy.
